The sync service on stage-04 runs as the deployment billing-sync in the namespace payments. Each pod runs two containers: a log-shipper sidecar and the application container. The release pipeline has just pushed the image registry.example.test/billing/sync-worker:2.8.1, and the deployment must be updated to it without touching the sidecar.

Write the exact kubectl command that updates the deployment to the new image.

The table shipments for last month has the columns ship_id, warehouse and weight_kg, and its rows are 1, Oslo, 12.0; 2, Bergen, 8.5; 3, Oslo, 20.5; 4, Tromso, 5.0; 5, Bergen, 14.0. Under the new contract, freight is billed at 3 euros per kg, on weights already net of packaging. The new contract covers only some of the warehouses; shipments from the others stay on the old contract.

What is the freight bill for the shipments covered by the new contract?

The table access_log has one row per request, with the columns req_id and hhmm, where hhmm is the time of the request on a 24-hour clock. Its rows are r1, 0905; r2, 0947; r3, 1012; r4, 1130; r5, 1204; r6, 1315. The maintenance window began at 10:00 and lasted until 12:00 that day.

How many requests happened during the maintenance window?
